messages:
Aisha: FYI restore for cust-17 failed at 01:03 UTC with KMS Decrypt denied :warning:
Aisha: log: `AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::222233334444:assumed-role/restore-agent is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222233334444:key/alpha-5678`
Tom: did we rotate that CMK overnight?
Aisha: rotation-runner finished at 00:30 UTC. looks like retire grants step happened as part of that job.
Ben: probable root: retire removed the grant that restore-agent needs. we should avoid a window with no valid grant for restore flows.
Jin: immediate mitigation: create a short-lived grant for restore-agent and resume job. prefer TTL 6-12h and tag with incident id. example:
```
aws kms create-grant \\
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222233334444:key/alpha-5678 \\
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/restore-agent \\
  --operations Decrypt,GenerateDataKey
```
Jin: pass back GrantToken to the restore process or make grant persistent for TTL.
Tom: avoid long-lived grants; they increase lateral access surface. do TTL 8h and mark with `incident=cust17-restore`
sec-bot: runbook-proposal: rotation should create mirrored grants on the new key before retiring existing grants and run a decrypt canary from restore role as verification.
Ben: medium-term pattern: two-phase rotation: (1) provision new key + mirror grants (2) run decrypt canary and confirm restore flows (3) retire old grants + cut alias. this prevents a grant-less interval.
Aisha: extra idea: maintain a small dedicated transition role (restore-transition-role) with tightly-scoped decrypt rights used only during rotations and audited heavily. gives a single principal to test during canary.
Tom: detection: CloudTrail query to alert when a RetireGrant event leaves a key with zero grants AND there were snapshot restore attempts or recent uploads for the same tenant in last 48h. escalate to eng-security.
Ben: also found a race condition in rotation-runner: multiple workers can run retire/create in parallel and retire can win. need leader election or atomic choreography.
Jin: created temporary grant now. GrantId: g-temp-cc7f. gave GrantToken to restore system.
Aisha: restore resumed at 01:12 UTC. monitoring for further Decrypt errors.
Tom: I'll open SEC ticket and assign infra oncall. include unit test case: simulate concurrent rotation runners and ensure grants remain available.
sec-bot: ticket SEC-7742 created: "rotation: prevent grant-loss during CMK swap; add canary + idempotency"
Ben: postmortem actions:
- immediate: TTL grant + verify last 72h of restores succeed
- short: add CloudTrail detection & SOC alert rule for orphaned-key retire events
- medium: implement two-phase rotation + mirror grants + canary decrypts
- long: add integration test and a small transition role; enrich restore logs with KeyId and GrantId stub for faster triage
Jin: restore completed at 01:28 UTC; integrity checks passed. notify customer and close incident after SEC-7742 has an owner and ETA.
Aisha: thanks. I'll draft the RBAC->KMS one-pager mapping which roles need grants for which snapshot buckets and link to the rotation PR.
Tom: ping infra when the PR is ready for review. closing when the PR and detection rule are in place. :white_check_mark:
